title: Miller's Midway carnival show and Willie Humphrey Sr.
summary: He spent about two years with Miller's carnival, with Calvin Distance, Jazz Baby and bandleader Willie Humphrey Sr. on clarinet.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, after I left Johnny Lee, I went with a carnival show, Miller's Midway shows. I stayed with Miller about, well, off and on. They'd go in winter quarters, you know, and come back out, you know what I mean, during the spring. Well, I stayed with Miller, I imagine around about two years. And we traveled, played different towns a week, staying in the towns a week, you know.
Yeah, did you hit very far away or just the towns around in the south, or where did you go?
Well, we played towns in the south. And with this show, particular show, went up for us, Kentucky, Tennessee, Missouri, like around up there, you know.
Was that a New Orleans band or just some of the fellas?
Well, they had some fellas from New Orleans on the show.
Anybody else from here, if you remember?
Well, there was a piano player from here, his name was Calvin Distance. He's dead. He was killed in St. Louis. I don't think he made any name here.
Records or any great name.
And a trombone player, they called him Jazz Baby.
He was from here?

Jazz was from here. Well, I mean, he stayed here a while, but he wasn't originally from here, you know. He came here and lived a while and he left with the show. Then Willie Humphrey's daddy was the band leader.
Oh, he was.
Willie, the old man. The old man. Played clarinet. Well, he was the band leader on that show. On this carnival. On this carnival. That's right.
I didn't know. We talked to him once after he had a stroke and he couldn't tell us very much. His memory wasn't really good then. Yeah, he was the band leader. He was very old.
That's right.
Just died last year, I believe, wasn't it? I think so, yeah.
That's right, last year. About a year ago.
He plays clarinet or did he play sax or what did he do?
He played clarinet. Clarinet. Strictly clarinet. That's what he played then.

And he was leader of the band. I didn't know that. Maybe he told us and I forgot. Then any other shows that came after that? Did you ever play here much in between? Did you ever play here in between the shows?
